name: VoroniX
summary: VoroniX is a CRM for companies of different kinds. It takes the data of a specific business (clients, services, staff, documents) and adapts to how that business works instead of forcing one fixed template.
audience: Companies that work with clients, appointments or deals and want clients, schedule, sales and client messages in one place.

features.name: Clients
features.description: One client base with contact details, visit and deal history, and notes.

features.name: Calendar and appointments
features.description: Booking by staff member and service, with appointment statuses.

features.name: Sales pipeline
features.description: Deals moved through stages, so the team sees where each client is.

features.name: Services and staff
features.description: The list of services and the team, with who provides what.

features.name: Inbox
features.description: Client messages in one place. The built-in AI assistant can answer clients using the business's own data.

features.name: Knowledge base
features.description: Business documents and rules that the built-in AI assistant relies on.

features.name: Analytics
features.description: A dashboard with the key numbers of the business.

features.name: Data import
features.description: Import existing data from Excel, CSV, Word and text files.

features.name: Separate workspace per business
features.description: Each business works in its own workspace with its own data.

nextStep: offer to walk through how VoroniX would work with their own data, and point them to the website for the next step.
